battle_traits.name: The Creeping Overgrowth
battle_traits.effect:
The creeping overgrowth is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token. The range of the creeping overgrowth is based on the number of friendly, overgrown tokens on the battlefield as shown:

• 0-2 overgrown tokens: 6"
• 3-5 overgrown tokens: 9"
• 6-8 overgrown tokens: 12"
• 9+ overgrown tokens: Whole battlefield

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to too.

battle_traits.name: Fury of The Forest
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit wholly within the creeping overgrowth and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: The unit using this ability has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: The Land Awakens
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO REVENANT INFANTRY unit or friendly Dryads unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: Endless Growth
battle_traits.declare: Pick each friendly SYLVANETH unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:


• Heal (X) the target, where X is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.

battle_traits.name: Reclaimed By Nature
battle_traits.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield, you can set up an Awakened Wyldwood on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly Awakened Wyldwoods and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

battle_traits.name: Creeping Dread
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit within the creeping overgrowth to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a HERO in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Fear of The Deepwoods
abilities.effect: In the 'Creeping Dread' ability, replace 'while it is not wholly within 12" of a HERO in their army' with 'while it is not wholly within 6" of a HERO in their army'.

abilities.name: Sacred Quarry
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy WARMASTER.

abilities.name: Nature's Titans
abilities.effect: When using the 'Endless Growth' ability, do not roll a D3 for MONSTER targets. Instead Heal (3) each of those targets.

abilities.name: Memories Of The Fallen
abilities.declare: For each friendly SYLVANETH unit or friendly Awakened Wyldwood that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Walk the Hidden Paths
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Awakened Wyldwood to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of another friendly Awakened Wyldwood and more than 9" from all enemies.

abilities.name: Spiteful Dusk
abilities.effect: The first time each phase an enemy unit within the creeping overgrowth uses a command, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after that command has been resolved. If that command was a reaction, instead inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the ability that command was a reaction to has been resolved.

entries.name: Spirit of The Dark Forest
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO to be the target.
entries.effect: Halve the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Spellsinger
entries.effect:
If this unit is a WIZARD, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
If this unit is not a WIZARD, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had WIZARD (1).

entries.name: Realmroot Guide
entries.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly SYLVANETH unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
entries.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Seed of Rebirth
entries.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a die. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Heal (D3) this unit.

entries.name: Amberglade Nectar
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Companion weapons used by friendly SYLVANETH units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

entries.name: Wychwood Glaive
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn to be the target.
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.

entries.name: Glamourweave
entries.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

entries.name: Acorn of the Ages
entries.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly Awakened Wyldwoods have WARD (5+).

entries.name: Ranu's Lamentiri
entries.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
entries.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

entries.name: Dancing Mystiflies
entries.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
entries.effect:
• If this unit is not a WIZARD, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had WIZARD (1). Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.
• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the creeping overgrowth, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

entries.name: Glamourweave
entries.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

entries.name: Amulet of Resonance
entries.effect: If this unit used the 'Eruption of Fury' ability this turn or you spent rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly SYLVANETH PRIEST wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Aspect of Harvestboon
entries.effect: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

entries.name: Aspect of Ironbark
entries.effect: When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit's damage pool. After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle.

entries.name: Aspect of Heartwood
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Endless Growth' ability
entries.effect:
If this unit is wholly within the creeping overgrowth, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would Heal (3) the target instead of rolling a dice, Heal (6) the target instead.
• If the target is KURNOTHI, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.

entries.name: Jade Thorns
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SYLVANETH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn, including attacks made with Companion weapons.

entries.name: Zephyrspite Rush
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SYLVANETH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

entries.name: Grasping Roots
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use RUN abilities.
• Subtract 1 from charge rolls for the target.

entries.name: Summon Gladewyrm
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Gladewyrm on the battlefield, pick a friendly SYLVANETH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Gladewyrm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Vengeful Skullroot
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Vengeful Skullroot on the battlefield, pick a friendly SYLVANETH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Vengeful Skullroot wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Spiteswarm Hive
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Spiteswarm Hive on the battlefield, pick a friendly SYLVANETH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Spiteswarm Hive wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Song Of The Lost
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can Heal (3) the target.
• If the target is not a MONSTER, ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Song Of War
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.

entries.name: Song Of Dread
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick an enemy unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to them and within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a MOVE ability and ends that move within the creeping overgrowth, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after that MOVE ability has been resolved.
